audit_metadata.frontend_stack: HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap 5.3, Bootstrap Icons 1.11, JavaScript, jQuery

critical_issues: Admission Enquiry, CRM, and Online Application workflow are completely missing (Modules 6-7).
Academics lacks Timetable, Classroom Diary, Homework submission, and Learning Resource Management (Modules 13-16).
Student Attendance daily period-wise entry is missing (Module 17); only staff attendance and student attendance reports exist.
School Operations including Transport, Library, Inventory, and Hostel are entirely missing (Modules 34-38).
Dedicated Student, Parent, and Teacher portals are unbuilt (Modules 39-41); currently only a unified Admin panel exists.
Communication gateways (SMS/WhatsApp/Email circulars) and Biometric hardware sync are not implemented (Modules 19, 42, 52).
No online payment gateway integration exists; all fee payments must be marked manually by operators.
Header notification bell and search icons are placeholder elements without popover/modal workflows.
